slides.text: In summary… a.k.a. the tl;dr – The best risk assessments incorporate qualitative and quantitative metrics – Your environment is already giving you risk signals – Risk is a tool that software development teams can add to their toolbox in order to help the business go fast and stay safe. – It’s not always wrong to accept SOME risk depending on your risk budget.
